name: WPSP Discount Wheel
author: WP Small Plugins

sections.description:
WPSP Discount Wheel shows visitors a spinning prize wheel in exchange for their email address, then reveals a coupon code — turning a plain email opt-in form into something visitors actually want to fill in.

Features

  • Spin-the-wheel popup with a configurable delay before it appears
  • Up to 8 prize segments, each with its own label and coupon code and the same chance of being picked
  • Every spin is resolved on the server, not in the browser, so the result is not decided by code the visitor can edit
  • Opt-ins list in the admin area — see every email and prize won
  • Spam protection: a hidden honeypot field and a limit of 10 spins per visitor per hour
  • Fully customizable text, colors, and button labels
  • Optional marketing consent checkbox (off, optional or required), never ticked by default, with each agreement recorded
  • A visitor who spins (or dismisses) the wheel isn’t shown it again for a while — 90 days after a spin and 30 after “No thanks” by default, both adjustable
  • Full WordPress Privacy API support: policy content, data export, and data erasure for stored opt-ins
  • No dependency on WooCommerce — works standalone with your own coupon codes

Upgrade to Pro

WPSP Discount Wheel Pro adds weighted odds per prize, multiple wheels, exit-intent and URL/device targeting, automatic WooCommerce coupon generation per spin, Mailchimp sync, and an analytics dashboard.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wpsp-discount-wheel folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WPSP Discount Wheel in your admin menu, enable the wheel, and set up your segments and coupon codes
sections.faq:
Does this create WooCommerce coupons automatically?

No — the free version shows a coupon code you enter yourself for each segment (create the coupon in WooCommerce, or any cart tool, first). Automatic per-spin coupon generation is a WPSP Discount Wheel Pro feature.

Is this plugin Multisite compatible?

No, WPSP Discount Wheel is designed for single-site use only.

Where can I get support?

Ask on the WordPress.org support forum — the Support tab in the plugin’s own settings links there too. WPSP Discount Wheel Pro customers get priority support instead of the forum queue.
